title: Deciding oil imports
body: A planning team must decide how much crude oil India should import next year. Global oil prices are rising, so the team cannot rely on a guess. It collects data on oil consumption over the past ten years and on recent survey data, and uses statistical tools to project two figures for next year: the likely demand for oil, 260 million tonnes, and the expected domestic production of oil, 30 million tonnes. (These figures are hypothetical and only for practice.) The team will recommend importing the gap between demand and domestic production. After the year is over, it plans to compare the actual figures with its projections to judge how good the import policy was.
